result.instructions: Tools for amego, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Find the invoice with number AA12301393 and show its buyer and amounts."; "List our invoices issued in October 2026 and total their amounts."; "Has the government accepted invoices AB00001111 to AB00001115?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes amego data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run amego_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run amego_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run amego_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. amego_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: amego_query_invoice
tools.title: Query invoice
tools.description: Look up one invoice by its invoice number, or by the order number it was issued for. Finds invoices dated within the last 180 days. amego: POST /json/invoice_query.

by.description: invoice = look up by invoice number; order = look up by order number.

value.description: The invoice number (at most 10 characters) or the order number (at most 40 characters).

tools.name: amego_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List the invoices of the company in a date range, one page at a time (headers only: number, dates, buyer, amounts, status). amego: POST /json/invoice_list.

date_select.description: Which date to filter on: 1 = invoice date, 2 = creation date.

tools.name: amego_get_invoice_upload_status
tools.title: Get invoice upload status
tools.description: Check whether the government has accepted each invoice number: the upload status, invoice type, status and total amount. Up to 50 numbers per call. amego: POST /json/invoice_status.

items.description: Invoice number, at most 10 characters, for example AA12301393.

invoice_numbers.description: Invoice numbers to check, up to 50.

tools.name: amego_get_invoice_file
tools.title: Get invoice PDF link
tools.description: Get a link to the PDF of one invoice (valid for 10 minutes). A carrier invoice can be downloaded only after it wins a prize. amego: POST /json/invoice_file.

by.description: invoice = look up by invoice number; order = look up by order number.

value.description: The invoice number (at most 10 characters) or the order number (at most 40 characters).

download_style.description: PDF layout. 0 = A4 full page (default for invoices with a buyer tax ID), 1 = A4 with address and A5, 2 = A4 with two A5, 3 = A5, 5 = QR code A4.

tools.name: amego_check_lottery_invoices
tools.title: Check lottery invoices
tools.description: List the company's invoices that won a prize in one two-month period. amego advises asking on the 1st day of an even month, after the draw. amego: POST /json/lottery_status.

period.description: Two-month period: 0 = Jan-Feb, 1 = Mar-Apr, 2 = May-Jun, 3 = Jul-Aug, 4 = Sep-Oct, 5 = Nov-Dec.

tools.name: amego_get_track_status
tools.title: Get number range status
tools.description: Show the status of the invoice number ranges (字軌) that use API number assignment, for one period. Optionally one range by its API code. amego: POST /json/track_status.

period.description: Two-month period: 0 = Jan-Feb, 1 = Mar-Apr, 2 = May-Jun, 3 = Jul-Aug, 4 = Sep-Oct, 5 = Nov-Dec.

track_api_code.description: API code of one number range, set in the amego back office. Omit for all ranges.

tools.name: amego_list_track_ranges
tools.title: List number ranges
tools.description: List every invoice number range (字軌) the company holds at amego for one period: the layer, the category, the start and end numbers, and how many remain. amego: POST /json/track_all.

period.description: Two-month period: 0 = Jan-Feb, 1 = Mar-Apr, 2 = May-Jun, 3 = Jul-Aug, 4 = Sep-Oct, 5 = Nov-Dec.

tools.name: amego_query_allowance
tools.title: Query allowance
tools.description: Look up one allowance (折讓單) by its allowance number. amego: POST /json/allowance_query.

allowance_number.description: Allowance number (折讓單編號), at most 16 characters.

tools.name: amego_list_allowances
tools.title: List allowances
tools.description: List the allowances (折讓單) of the company in a date range, one page at a time. amego: POST /json/allowance_list.

date_select.description: Which date to filter on: 1 = allowance date, 2 = creation date.

tools.name: amego_get_allowance_upload_status
tools.title: Get allowance upload status
tools.description: Check whether the government has accepted each allowance number: the upload status and the total amount. Up to 50 numbers per call. amego: POST /json/allowance_status.

items.description: Allowance number (折讓單編號), at most 16 characters.

allowance_numbers.description: Allowance numbers to check, up to 50.

tools.name: amego_get_allowance_file
tools.title: Get allowance PDF link
tools.description: Get a link to the PDF of one allowance (折讓單). amego: POST /json/allowance_file.

allowance_number.description: Allowance number (折讓單編號), at most 16 characters.

tools.name: amego_lookup_company_name
tools.title: Look up company name
tools.description: Look up the registered company name for up to 20 tax IDs (統一編號), from the Ministry of Finance data. amego: POST /json/ban_query.

tax_ids.description: 8-digit tax IDs to look up, up to 20.

tools.name: amego_check_mobile_barcode
tools.title: Check mobile barcode
tools.description: Check whether a mobile carrier barcode (手機條碼) is valid. amego: POST /json/barcode.

barcode.description: The mobile barcode, 8 characters starting with /, for example /ABC+1+2.
